title: Invariant Producer Bindings
description: Complete optional adopter-owned producer obligations projected only by registered binding to .devai/config/invariant-producers.json. Every binding for an invariant must be discharged by exact candidate/task/result custody; generic action matching cannot substitute (ADR-SCR-0017).

subject.description: Reviewed semantic obligation identifier, not proof of source selection. Exact task input selectors and result census bind the implementing source population. Duplicate invariant/subject pairs refuse at semantic validation.

requiredTestIds.description: Nonempty subset of the exact complete resultPopulation IDs required for this subject. Each must actually execute and pass; declarations, skips, cache hits and another subject's results discharge nothing.
